targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS reveals FROM amboy.audit_log WHERE action='detokenize' AND outcome='revealed' AND ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo();
SELECT count(*) AS denied FROM amboy.audit_log WHERE action='detokenize' AND outcome <> 'revealed';

panels.title: Ungrounded figures flagged by the agent

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum((detail->>'ungrounded')::int),0) AS ungrounded FROM amboy.audit_log WHERE action='llm_call';
SELECT count(*) AS ingests FROM amboy.audit_log WHERE action='ingest';
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, action AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM amboy.audit_log WHERE ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;
SELECT ts, actor, resource AS token, outcome FROM amboy.audit_log WHERE action='detokenize' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;
